findings.claim: The module header says the script writes bare hex in every one of its eighteen calls.
findings.counterexample: The parse run over the branch script yields 24 definitions; the header was left at 18 while the labelCanonDrift doc comment was corrected in ded0b574 — same stale-doc class.

findings.claim: The forms-coupling test locks charter § 4c(ii): one template per type: value applying that label.
findings.counterexample: The assertion only checks membership in the canon: labels: [] passes (the loop never runs), docs.yml carrying type: bug passes, two type labels pass. Strengthen to exact equality with type: <basename>.

labelCanonDrift pushes every canonical name absent from the live list into missing and conforming requires missing.length === 0; merging makes six names canonical before the batch-one run creates them, so totem doctor --parity reports gh-issue-label-canon non-conforming on this repo for the whole interval. Not CI-red (--parity is opt-in). Undisclosed in the record and the PR.

findings.claim: Under -WhatIf, Merge-Label's inner gh issue list / gh issue edit / gh label delete print instead of calling.
findings.counterexample: The shadow's Write-Host emits to the information stream, so $issues is empty and the foreach never iterates: a full -WhatIf run prints gh issue list and gh label delete for all 22 merges and zero gh issue edit lines.

findings.claim: The dry-run test asserts one line per would-be call.
findings.counterexample: It asserts >= 24 against an observed 52 (24 edit + 6 create + 22 delete); the exact count is derivable from realCanon() and canon.merges.length.

findings.claim: The -WhatIf output reads like the authored call.
findings.counterexample: On Windows the redirected pwsh console prints an ASCII hyphen where the file holds U+2014 (a console-encoding artifact; node reads the same bytes as an em-dash and the real call passes UTF-16 args). Cosmetic; a description-text assertion on the dry run would fail the Windows leg.

findings.claim: No changeset is owed (the only published-source change is a comment).
findings.counterexample: Holds; noted that adding one would flip the HARD legs gate on via the .changeset/** glob and require a deposit before push.

findings.claim: Four open questions remain for the operator.
findings.counterexample: The diff ships all four recommendations; the operator's design greenlight adopted them. The line was stale.

findings.claim: A non-canon labels: entry makes GitHub silently create a squatter label.
findings.counterexample: Not grounded: GitHub may drop an unknown template label rather than create it. The guard is correct either way; the prose is reworded to hedge.

verdict: no blocking finding; three material folded or disclosed, six minor folded or noted (F6, F7 noted); termination: targeted re-check of the folded lines, no further full leg
